sources.title: gold workbook
quotes: The official troy ounce gold prices used for the conversion were set by the U.S. Congress at $20.67 for 1900–32, $25.56 for 1933, $34.95 for 1934, and $35.00 for 1935–70.

Unit values were estimated using average world market gold price for 1900–67 and the Englehard’s average gold price quotation of refined gold for 1968 to current year as reported in the MP91 and the MYB.
